body:
## Summary

`ubuntu/24.04/dind/dind-entrypoint.sh` starts the nested daemon in `launch_dockerd()` with:

```sh
nohup /usr/bin/dockerd \
  --host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock \
  --data-root="$DIND_DATA_ROOT" \
  --storage-driver="$storage_driver" \
  >>"$DIND_LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
```

It does not pass `--live-restore`, and there is no way to add extra `dockerd` arguments. So the nested daemon always runs with the Docker default, `LiveRestoreEnabled=false`. If that `dockerd` ever restarts, every container on it is killed: for example a manual `pkill dockerd` plus a relaunch, a future supervisor/restart loop, or an OOM kill followed by a relaunch.

This came up in downstream incident link-assistant/hive-mind#2900. There, the **host** dockerd was OOM-killed and restarted, and every container was force-killed with exit 137, including the box-dind bot container and four task containers. Fixing the host daemon is hive-mind's job. The nested daemon in box-dind is the same failure mode one level down, so it is cheap to harden it too.

## Reproduction

In a box-dind container (checked against `main` @ 3e613a79):

```sh
docker info -f '{{.LiveRestoreEnabled}}'   # -> false
```

A minimal self-contained repro of what a daemon restart does to containers, run in a throwaway privileged `docker:29-dind`, is here: [`experiments/issue-2900-live-restore-dind-repro.sh`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2900-5e605ce4e476/experiments/issue-2900-live-restore-dind-repro.sh). Output with dockerd 29.9.0:

```
== A. live-restore=false (Docker default) ==
before dockerd restart: running exit=0 pid=344
after  dockerd restart: exited exit=137 pid=0
== B. enable live-restore with SIGHUP (reload), no restart ==
before reload: running exit=0 pid=743 live-restore=false
after  reload: running exit=0 pid=743 live-restore=true
== C. live-restore on: restart dockerd again ==
after  dockerd restart: running exit=0 pid=743 (pid before restart: 743)
```

## Workaround (today, without a box change)

Write `/etc/docker/daemon.json` with `{"live-restore": true}` inside the container before the entrypoint starts dockerd. For example, bind-mount it with `-v ./daemon.json:/etc/docker/daemon.json:ro`. dockerd reads that file even when it is started with flags. On an already running container, write the file and send `SIGHUP` to the nested dockerd (`kill -HUP <pid>`): `live-restore` is a reloadable option, so this needs no restart.

## Suggested fix

Pass `--live-restore` in `launch_dockerd()` by default, with an env opt-out, e.g. `DIND_LIVE_RESTORE=1` (set it to `0` to disable). Optionally also add a generic `DIND_DOCKERD_EXTRA_ARGS`.

**One caveat to handle.** dockerd refuses to start when the same directive comes both from a flag and from `daemon.json`. Verified with [`experiments/issue-2900-flag-config-conflict.sh`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2900-5e605ce4e476/experiments/issue-2900-flag-config-conflict.sh):

```
== dockerd --live-restore + daemon.json {"live-restore": true} ==
exit=1
unable to configure the Docker daemon with file /etc/docker/daemon.json: the following directives are specified both as a flag and in the configuration file: live-restore: (from flag: true, from file: true)
```

So the flag should only be added when `/etc/docker/daemon.json` does not already contain a `live-restore` key. A sketch:

```sh
DIND_LIVE_RESTORE="${DIND_LIVE_RESTORE:-1}"
live_restore_args=""
if [ "$DIND_LIVE_RESTORE" = "1" ] && ! grep -qs '"live-restore"' /etc/docker/daemon.json; then
  live_restore_args="--live-restore"
fi
# ... nohup /usr/bin/dockerd ... $live_restore_args >>"$DIND_LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
```

This should be harmless. Live-restore only changes what happens when dockerd stops, and the nested daemon is not a Swarm node; older Docker releases reject live-restore in swarm mode.

## References

- Docker docs, "Live restore": https://docs.docker.com/engine/daemon/live-restore/
- Downstream incident and the hive-mind preflight warning: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/2900, https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2902
title: dind: start the nested dockerd with --live-restore (daemon restart kills every nested container)
